{{Top|leg}}
A '''Selanikio Sportster''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. Considered old in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], it was an open-[[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] design propelled by an [[Aratech Arrow]] engine. [[Veeka Gault]] owned a Selanikio Sportster shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] before crashing it into [[Annileen Calwell]]'s [[X-31 landspeeder|X-31]].<ref name="Kenobi novel">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref> [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] owned one as a young man on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
